footer.description: The intelligent design system for the modern hospitality industry. From boutique cafes to enterprise restaurant groups.

hero.subtitle: Davoriq is the ultimate digital QR menu software for restaurants. Create stunning contactless menus that increase sales, streamline dine-in ordering, and elevate your customer experience.

steps.title: Create Categories
steps.desc: Organize your menu into logical sections like Starters, Mains, and Drinks. Simply name them and set their order.

steps.title: Add Menu Items
steps.desc: Upload photos, set prices, and add descriptions. You can update these instantly whenever your kitchen makes a change.

steps.title: Design Your Brand
steps.desc: Use our Design Studio to pick colors, fonts, and layouts that match your restaurant's unique personality.

steps.title: Optimize with AI
steps.desc: Activate AI heatmaps to highlight popular items and set 'Happy Hour' rules to automatically adjust prices.

workflow.why_desc: A well-organized digital menu doesn't just look good—it sells more. By using our **AI Heatmap** and **Category Optimization**, you can guide your customers toward your highest-margin items automatically.

automation.desc: Stop worrying about updating your menu for every holiday. Davoriq automatically changes your themes and atmosphere effects to match the season, and optimizes your prices for Happy Hour.

testimonial.quote: "The design studio is a game-changer. We've seen a 22% increase in average order value through AI heatmaps."
testimonial.author: Marcus Sterling

cta.subtitle: Join thousands of world-class restaurants transforming their digital presence today.
